attribution.notice: The upstream vanilla-plus tweaks collection read for this entry is authored by BlakeBr0 and published under the MIT licence. It was read at the pinned revision below to write a behaviour specification. Ravel's counterpart is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or derived from the original's source text.

publication.notes: The fetched source lives only in the public repository's ignored fixture tree at tests/fixtures/local/m6-clean-room/ and is not tracked in either repository. The specification derived from it is tracked at specifications/m6-foundation/RVL-086.md and is not in the public repository. Neither is publishable while the names surface is unresolved. The fetched tree includes the entry's binary assets (62 texture files) and about three hundred declarative model, block-state, loot, tag and recipe documents; the textures were not opened and the declarative documents were read only for the census the specification's section 5.7 records.
publication.reviewedBy: structure-reviewed 2026-09-05 by an independent Claude reader that had seen no upstream source; it read the specification first and then the counterpart's module list and public types to see whether a structural noun had crossed, after the counterpart was implemented; verdict: accepted; the specification's read/inferred/unknown markers and closing coverage statement were checked present. No human has read the specification in full.

rights.basis: MIT, read at the source rather than trusted from the inventory. Reading, modification and derivative works are permitted, which is what source-informed reimplementation requires. The counterpart must not copy source text; the specification written from this read carries no upstream identifier, which checks/verify-spec-identifiers.sh was run over and returned no finding.
MIT imposes no behavioural restriction and the inventory records behaviour as cleared and sourceUse as permitted for this entry.

Unchanged from the inventory. MIT does not grant trademark rights, so the project's own name, its mod id and its content identifiers remain unresolved. The specification therefore names nothing after the original, and no save-compatible identifier mapping is specified. The constraint bites less here than for a catalogue entry, because this entry's value is its decision rules and arithmetic rather than its content list, but it still means a counterpart cannot be save-compatible with the original.

62 texture files were fetched with the source and were not opened. The inventory records textures as cleared for this artifact and the licence reserves no asset separately. Nothing upstream is tracked or shipped; any counterpart art is rewritten from reference under policies/source-access.json and recorded in the package's assets-provenance.json.

The fetched tree carries no binary model file; its models are declarative model and block-state documents fetched with the source and read only for the registration census the specification records. The inventory records models as cleared for this artifact and the licence reserves no asset separately. Nothing upstream is tracked or shipped.

The fetched tree contains no sound file, which is what the inventory's not-applicable verdict for this artifact holds. The specification refers to sounds only as host sound effects reused by the entry's blocks, items and interactions, never as material shipped with it.

No branding material was fetched or read; the display name, logo and author identity are excluded regardless of licence status under policies/source-access.json. The mod descriptor's display name, author, credits, update feed and product page were read only to confirm the dependency and side declarations the specification's section 2 and section 16 state, and none of that text is transcribed. The descriptor declares no logo file.

sources.use: The upstream implementation, fetched as a source archive into the public repository's ignored fixture tree at tests/fixtures/local/m6-clean-room/tar/ and extracted alongside it, and read to write specifications/m6-foundation/RVL-086.md. Version correspondence to the pinned pack artifact -- exact: the build script at this revision declares version '1.21.1-9.0.6' and an archive base name that together produce the pinned artifact file name PickleTweaks-1.21.1-9.0.6.jar, and its properties file declares the game version 1.21.1. The revision was located by reading the build-script history on the branch that holds the 1.21 line: the project publishes no tag and no release, keeps one rolling branch per game-version line, and the commit immediately after this one raises the declared version to the next release on the same branch, so this commit is the only one whose build script declares the pinned version. No decompilation was performed and no jar was opened.

One inventory-adjacent observation rather than a correction: the descriptor also carries an optional accessory-slot integration with a mod outside this wave, which the plan row does not list because it is not mandatory; the specification's section 15 records it as host-blocked.

sources.use: Records the fetch. No fetch tool exists in either repository; the earlier rows were written by hand and this one was fetched with a plain archive download from the same host and appended in the same form, digesting the archive with sha256 as the existing rows do. The digest binds the archive as fetched at the time above rather than asserting that the host re-serves identical bytes. No pre-existing row for this repository was in the file; this is its first.
